transcript.content: I feel I let a student down today, and I worry this mistake will mean I will never be trusted again. This feeling of failure and of not being trusted began with a specific recent incident at work, and I keep ruminating on it, which affects my work performance and sleep. I feel completely hopeless and have even thought about ending my life and leaving this world.
